tests.name: json_pointer_to_string_empty
tests.intent: Verify that to_string() on an empty json_pointer returns an empty string without failing.

tests.name: json_pointer_to_string_plain
tests.intent: Verify to_string() on a plain json_pointer with no escaped characters uses the fast copy path.

tests.name: json_pointer_to_string_escaped
tests.intent: Verify to_string() on a json_pointer containing tildes and slashes properly formats escaped tokens.

tests.name: json_pointer_parse_one_pass_plain
tests.intent: Probe the one-pass parsing algorithm on a standard plain json pointer string.

tests.name: json_pointer_parse_one_pass_escaped
tests.intent: Probe one-pass parsing with unescaping logic triggered by tilde characters.

tests.name: json_pointer_parse_edge_trailing_slash
tests.intent: Verify parsing behavior and to_string output for a json pointer ending with a slash.

tests.name: json_pointer_parse_edge_consecutive_slashes
tests.intent: Verify pointer parsing with consecutive slashes representing empty reference tokens.

tests.name: json_pointer_parse_single_slash
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a json pointer consisting of a single slash.

tests.name: json_pointer_invalid_escape_handling
tests.intent: Probe exception behavior when parsing a pointer with invalid escape sequences.

tests.name: json_pointer_unflatten_roundtrip
tests.intent: Exercise unflatten integration using the optimized pointer splitting logic.

tests.name: json_pointer_patch_integration
tests.intent: Exercise json patch using pointers parsed by the new one-pass scanner.

tests.name: json_pointer_concat_operator
tests.intent: Verify pointer concatenation operator / creates valid pointers printable via to_string().

tests.name: json_pointer_concat_string
tests.intent: Verify pointer concatenation with a string literal works correctly.

tests.name: json_pointer_parent_pointer
tests.intent: Verify parent_pointer() execution on pointers built via one-pass parsing.

tests.name: json_pointer_back_and_pop
tests.intent: Verify back() and pop_back() functionality on pointers parsed in one pass.

tests.name: json_pointer_contains_lookup
tests.intent: Verify contains() method using json pointers.

tests.name: json_pointer_at_lookup
tests.intent: Verify at() lookup method using json pointers.

tests.name: json_pointer_value_lookup
tests.intent: Verify value() method fallback using json pointers.

tests.name: json_pointer_subscript_access
tests.intent: Verify operator[] access using json pointers.

tests.name: json_pointer_long_complex_string
tests.intent: Test parsing and roundtrip string serialization of a long, complex json pointer with multiple escapes.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise JSON pointer parsing with escaped tokens containing tilde (~0) to reach the unescape else branch.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise JSON pointer parsing with slash escapes (~1) to reach the unescape else branch.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise JSON pointer parsing with multiple tilde escapes in a single token to reach the unescape else branch.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise JSON pointer parsing with mixed tilde and slash escapes to reach the unescape else branch.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercise unflattening a JSON object with escaped keys using pointers that hit the unescape else branch.
